title: Neutral post-failure traceback-frame census of the complete P11 centered quaternion comparison

source_identity.disposition: The diagnostic observes this explicitly identified held candidate. It does not promote the candidate, resolve its performance hold, or change the accepted runtime.
source_identity.execution_checkout: Separate clean checkout of the exact held candidate commit/tree; external driver and receipts remain outside it.
source_identity.publication_branch: New isolated branch from the freshly observed C035 evidence publication. Its documentation-only Git identity must not be substituted for the exact request execution identity.

basis.interpretation: The retained stack establishes a quaternion-distance accumulation refusal, not the current carrier, key, exact operands, reuse-miss reason, complete remaining cost, or a global hotspot. Checkpoint033's right-eye/key-36 identification must not be carried forward as an observation of this new refusal.

required_order: Re-observe live ownership, Issue #26, draft PR heads and the exact enclosing checkpoint035 publication; select a new isolated diagnostic scope without advancing another owner's branch.
Verify the complete held-candidate commit/tree and actual source/input inventories. Preserve the accepted runtime identity separately. Stop for a new scope decision if the candidate source differs.

Source-review and freeze an external driver that preserves the complete original P11 source loading, compiler/shared budget, export arguments and lifecycle, while retaining the original exception object after the request fails.

Predeclare one uninstrumented and one capture request on the same immutable candidate, with original settings and limits, unique output paths and serialized execution. Do not perform this work during another open product or validation run.
Read bounded native traceback-frame data only after the capture request has failed. Preserve the original exception, diagnostic and failed request status; serialize after product execution has ended.
Require the complete neutrality comparison before treating any captured locals as authoritative. Preserve every failed capture or comparison attempt.

Independently reconstruct the existing orientation-proof reuse predicate from frozen source and captured native fields. Publish the actual refused operands and classified reuse-miss reasons without selecting or implementing an optimization.

all_must_match: Exact held-candidate commit/tree, runtime and source-input bytes, interpreter identity, and stable before/after input inventories
Complete request settings, source manifests/units, program revision, tolerances and resource limits
Shared operation total, reach operation total and their construction-work difference
Every entry and value in the complete work category map
Every stock-reported cache occupancy, including the reported work-cache entry count
Failure type/message, complete diagnostic and the actual resource-limit outcome
Underlying product traceback frame sequence, source/code identities and refusal statement
neutrality_gate.stack_comparison: Retain both complete stacks. Identify any external driver frame explicitly; allow only a documented actual checkout-root mapping when needed. Do not discard product frames or normalize the failure statement.
neutrality_gate.cache_distinction: The observed 256-entry count is the reported work-cache occupancy. Label any separately captured independent-arithmetic cache snapshot as such; do not infer equality of distinct caches.
neutrality_gate.timing: Retain elapsed measurements and any elapsed-limit outcome. Equal operation maps do not establish elapsed neutrality. This census performs no performance-acceptance experiment and does not resolve the candidate's existing hold.
neutrality_gate.failure_action: If any neutrality condition fails, captured locals are not authoritative for optimization selection. Retain the mismatch and stop the proposed analysis until its cause is resolved in a separately identified attempt.

post_failure_capture.boundary: After the unchanged complete request has raised, using its retained original exception and traceback frames
post_failure_capture.mechanism: An external frozen driver reads existing frames; no live execution instrumentation or participating-function patch is installed.
required_fields: Actual _key_comparisons index and exact rational clock, carrier ID, source frame path, and pending/completed carrier order
Available source, phase, context and owner identities, preserving which facts are frame snapshots and which are post-cleanup state
Actual supplied quaternion native types and binary64 bits
Sign-selected expected quaternion exact numerator/denominator pairs, orientation radius and typed claim limit
The failing l1 component's value, point, error and accumulated distance; identify the captured checked-add operands whose charge refused
Available completed same-key _centered_orientation_proof payloads, seals, actual/source operands, radius, typed claim, operand domain and completed error
Native dispatch/domain facts needed to establish that the capture observed the same admitted path as the uninstrumented request
serialization_rules: Use source-reviewed readers for explicitly admitted native scalars and bounded containers; serialize exact rationals as integer numerator/denominator fields and floats by exact bits where identity matters.

Predeclare fixed shape, count, depth and scalar-size bounds for the selected frames and records. Retain only the bounded data needed for this failed comparison and its existing completed-proof candidates; do not serialize the entire heap or arbitrary frame object graphs.
Do not invoke arbitrary attribute getters, repr/str methods, reducers, copying hooks or product numerical helpers to inspect a captured object.
Do not mutate frame locals, operands, receipts, caches, observers or source state. Diagnostic retained data is never supplied back to product evaluation.
Label cleanup-dependent observations accurately. Missing or changed-after-cleanup evidence remains missing; do not reconstruct an earlier live identity from assumption.
Serialization and independent analysis occur after request termination and are reported separately from product work and elapsed measurements.

reuse_miss_analysis.method: Reconstruct the existing predicate in frozen source order from authoritative captured fields, without executing or changing the live proof path.
classifications: No suitable completed same-key orientation proof was available
Payload shape or seal did not match
Actual supplied quaternion identity or typed values differed
Operand domain or completed result type differed
Another specifically identified predicate or missing observation prevented a conclusion
reuse_miss_analysis.stop_rule: Report the actual first mismatch for each examined completed proof and whether any identical completed numerical calculation is established. Similar geometry or a related source frame is insufficient. A possible reuse opportunity requires a separately selected numerical/native-dispatch/storage/charge derivation before any implementation.
claims_forbidden: A particular current carrier or clock inferred only from checkpoint033 or aggregate counters
A global hotspot inferred from the final refused operation
A complete-request saving or remaining deficit inferred from capped totals
A successful final source/certificate admission, accepted export, or future P11 pass

deliverables: Frozen external driver and bounded serialization specification, with exact source hash and original-request equivalence review
Both complete failed request results, commands, raw streams, source/input inventories and immutable candidate identity
Post-failure native-field census with actual carrier/clock/operand and receipt provenance
Independent full neutrality comparison and source-bound reuse-miss analysis
A final diagnostic disposition preserving all limitations and the held performance/runtime acceptance state
hold_conditions: Candidate commit/tree or original request inputs/settings cannot be bound exactly
Capturing the exception requires a profiler, work hook, participating-function patch or changed native admission
Any uninstrumented/capture count, cache, diagnostic, limit or product-stack mismatch remains unexplained
Required locals cannot be serialized within the declared native bounds without foreign dispatch or mutation
Existing proof-reuse decisions cannot be reconstructed from authoritative observations
excluded: Runtime optimization or changed product/test/oracle behavior during the census
Profiler or trace hooks; work/check hooks; scalar, arithmetic or participating-reader wrappers; changed observers
Resuming or resetting a failed request under a fresh allowance, or evaluating its unvisited tail as if the original request had completed
Changes to fixtures, supplied output tracks, horizons, fps, helpers, limits, tolerances, radii, floors or signed expressions
Relaxing an existing claim or reuse predicate, signed-product factoring, cross-clock reuse or a new persistent numerical cache
Widening the implemented product-pair selection bound
L03 direct-seed or 64-update cursor changes; L03 remains a separate unchanged control
P16 retained-clock work, P23 producer sampling and advancement of held candidates from other scopes
Timing reruns, sampling tuning, exclusions or pooling intended to resolve the candidate's separate performance hold
Other-owner branch advancement, shared-overview edits, hosted or paid CI, forced updates, merge or release acceptance
final_disposition_boundary: Completion of this diagnostic does not accept candidate 4ca73909, change accepted runtime d2f0088, resolve performance acceptance, pass the 24/28 original-recording gate, or authorize a subsequent implementation.
